findings.title: Real runsc full-suite failed in a Linux symlink-cleanup fixture
findings.evidence: The actual run-acceptance wrapper exited 1 after 288295 ms. Its retained trusted receipt has outcome=fail, exitCode=1, started 2026-10-14T00:16:56.674Z, finished 00:21:28.112Z (271438 ms), and no certificate. The verified stdout artifact (SHA-256 e1e62bac...) shows dependency-lock admission, typecheck, clean build, 26-test-file discovery and 13 completed passing Node test groups (58 tests) before local-integration.test.js failed: ENOTDIR rmdir '/tmp/orloom-local-integration-4RfU45/bare.git/objects'. The source fixture removes a symlink using rmdir, which is invalid on Linux; the target test did not reach its intended completion. Stage node-tests ended 1.
findings.boundedDirection: Repair only the cross-platform symlink teardown in the source test fixture, preserve its fail-closed Git security assertion, then freeze a new source SHA, run mandatory exact gates and independent source review before a fresh cloud package and one new disposable attempt. Do not relabel this FAIL receipt or reuse its started runtime marker as a retry authorization.

runtimeInterpretation: The wrapper's nested proof-failure.json says UNKNOWN at passing-real-coordinator-run because runtime-acceptance.mjs line 161 asserted expected PASS and received the persisted FAIL. That is an outer proof assertion, not an ambiguous verifier effect: SQL snapshot and receipt conclusively show a terminal FAIL attempt and zero certificates.

No timeout or OOM is evidenced: receipt and suite exited 1 with the explicit ENOTDIR frame before the unchanged 360/390/405/420-second bounds. Runsc configuration records 2 GiB memory, no network, read-only root, nonroot user and no-new-privileges; cgroup stream has 881 observations but measured peak memory is unavailable, so no peak-memory claim is made.

The image binding, staging identity, run marker and receipt request all identify f6023ac, the 139-file source manifest, node-repo-suite-v1 v5 and image sha256:215e6268...; protected-host and capacity preflight admitted 3.40 GiB available memory against the 2.95 GiB required floor.
retentionAndCleanup: The source-bound read-only PostgreSQL snapshot reports querySucceeded=true, exactly one FAIL attempt and zero certificates; its SHA-256 checksum 644bdbd8... matches the retained snapshot bytes.

The before-cleanup archive hash matches its retention record. Cleanup exited 0 after checking the snapshot and removing only ledger-owned disposable PostgreSQL resources and root-only database-url; the after-cleanup archive is retained at its recorded hash.

Postflight exited 0 and records the protected codex-universal container still running at the expected ID/start/restart/runtime tuple, no packet-labeled disposable resources, no database-url, and retained evidence/artifacts.
limits: This run supplies genuine negative cloud verifier evidence, not a full-suite PASS, certificate, delivery publication, production activation, or parent commercial acceptance. No host/provider action was performed by this read-only review.
